title: AM GENERAL LLC: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK (497 affected)
summary: WHEN TESTED ACCORDING TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD 301, "FUEL SYSTEM INTEGRITY". RUPTURES IN THE FUEL SYSTEM OCCURRED IN A 30 MPH FRONTAL COLLISION, ALLOWING FUEL TO LEAK. THE HARDWARE USED TO ATTACH THE BODY TO THE CHASSIS FAILED IN THE TEST. MOVEMENT OF THE VEHICLE"S BODY DURING THE COLLISION RESULTED IN RUPTURES IN FUEL SYSTEM.

title: AMERICAN LAFRANCE LLC: STEERING:POWER ASSIST:HOSE:FLUID (473 affected)
summary: NON OIL-RESISTANT HEATER HOSE WAS USED INSTEAD OF THE CORRECT POWER STEERING SUCTION HOSE. THIS HOSE ALLOWS THE POWER STEERING FLUID TO PASS TO THE PUMP FROM THE FLUID RESERVOIR. HOSE WILL SWELL AND FALL OUT OF PLACE AND THE POWER STEERING FLUID WILL LEAK OUT.

title: Yokohama Tire Corporation: TIRES:PLY (1,105 affected)
summary: NON COMPLIANCE WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD 119, NEW PNEUAMTIC TIRES, NON PASSENGER VEHICLES. A SEPARATION MAY DEVELOP IN SERVICE BETWEEN THE PLIES IN THE SHOULDER TREAD AREA.

title: Mazda North American Operations: LIGHTING:LAMP OR SOCKET:TAIL LIGHTS (87,468 affected)
summary: REAR LAMPS DO NOT MEET THE MAXIMUM INTENSITY REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT". THE LAMPS PRODUCE TOO MUCH LIGHT.

title: ATLAS COPCO N.A., INC: TIRES:PLY (69 affected)
summary: TIRES HAVE FAILED TO MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD 109, NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES, ENDURANCE TEST.

title: GRUMMAN ALLIED IND., INC.: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT CONTROL ARM:UNKNOWN T (308 affected)
summary: BALLJOINTS, WHICH CONNECT THE STEERING LINKAGE COMPONENTS TO THE WHEELS, MAY NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED CORRECTLY AND COULD DETACH.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC SYSTEM (450 affected)
summary: THE HYDROVAC CANISTERS WERE MODIFIED AND DO NOT WORK WELL WITH THE REST OF THE BRAKING SYSTEM. MORE PEDAL EFFORT IS NEEDED IN ORDER TO BRING VEHICLE TO A HALT AND THE MAXIMUM STOPPING DISTANCE IS INCREASED.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (16,000 affected)
summary: THE ENGINE SHUTDOWN CABLE LOCATED BETWEEN THE DASH BOARD AND FIREWALL, MAY INTERFERE WITH THE ACCELERATOR LINKAGE.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: WHEELS (24,166 affected)
summary: WHEEL MAY DEVELOP CRACKS AND FRACTURES FROM OPERATING ON ROUGH ROADS. (SPOKES WILL PRIMARILY BE AFFECTED).

title: ARMSTRONG RUBBER CO.: TIRES:TREAD (896 affected)
summary: TIRES FAILED TO MEET HIGH SPEED REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD 109, NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES. TESTS RESULTED IN TREAD SEPARATION ON A MAJORITY OF THE TIRES.

title: General Motors, LLC: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC (30,868 affected)
summary: REAR BRAKE HOSES WERE NOT PROPERLY MANUFACTURED AND DO NOT CONFORM TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD 106, "BRAKE HOSES". HOSES COULD COME LOOSE FROM THE END FITTINGS WHEN SUBJECTED TO A PULLING FORCE.

title: General Motors, LLC: AIR CONDITIONER (2,940 affected)
summary: PLASTIC PLUG LOCATED ON TOP OF THE FRONT AIR CONDITIONER WAS NOT REMOVED DURING ASSEMBLY. THIS DEFECT DISRUPTS NORMAL OPERATION OF EVAPORATOR BLOWER HOUSING.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:SHOE AND DRUM SYSTEM:DRUM (40 affected)
summary: REAR BRAKE DRUMS MAY CRACK IN SERVICE, DUE TO AN ERROR IN THE MANUFACTURING PROCESS.

title: Yamaha Motor Corporation, USA: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK (510 affected)
summary: FUEL TANK WAS DESIGNED IMPROPERLY. IF MOTORCYCLE TANK IS FULL AND LEFT IN HOT SUNLIGHT, GAS WILL EXPAND BEYOND THE MAXIMUM CAPACITY LEVEL OF TANK.

title: MITSUBISHI MANUFACTURING AMER: ENGINE:OTHER PARTS (2,489 affected)
summary: OIL PRESSURE GAUGE SENDING UNIT, LOCATED ON THE RIGHT HAND SIDE OF THE ENGINE, MAY LEAK OIL. ENGINE PARTS COULD BE DAMAGED DUE TO RESULTING LACK OF LUBRICATION.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: STEERING:POWER:GEAR BOX (5,739 affected)
summary: STEERING GEAR MAY NOT BE SECURE BECAUSE OF A LOOSE BOLT ON STEERING GEAR BRACKET. BOLTS HOLD STEERING GEAR BRACKET TO CHASSIS.

title: Ford Motor Company: STEERING:POWER:GEAR BOX (2,757 affected)
summary: INADEQUATE LUBRICATION OF THE STEERING SHAFT COULD CAUSE STEERING SHAFT ASSEMBLIES TO SEPARATE WITHOUT WARNING.
